description.en: The Bar–Boljare motorway, including the open Smokovac–Mateševo section and the Mateševo–Andrijevica extension.
description.ro: Autostrada Bar–Boljare, cu secțiunea deschisă Smokovac–Mateševo și extinderea Mateševo–Andrijevica.

sources.title: Monteput: contract signed for the Mateševo–Andrijevica section
Monteput: preparatory works begin on Mateševo–Andrijevica
OpenStreetMap contributors: proposed A1 route relation 7723188, downloaded 12 October 2026
Monteput: Bar–Boljare motorway portfolio, Smokovac–Mateševo length approximately 41.5 km
Government of Montenegro: official service of Smokovac–Mateševo begins on 14 July 2022 at 08:00

note.en: Monteput reported the start of preparatory works.
note.ro: Monteput a raportat inceperea lucrarilor pregatitoare.

note.en: Monteput reports a length of 23 km. The OSM alignment relation continues north of Andrijevica towards Boljare; the mapped section ends at the alignment point nearest Andrijevica. Contract value omitted because the cited source does not state the VAT basis.
note.ro: Monteput indica o lungime de 23 km. Relatia OSM continua spre nord de Andrijevica catre Boljare; geometria sectiunii se termina la punctul de aliniament cel mai apropiat de Andrijevica. Valoarea contractului este omisa deoarece sursa citata nu precizeaza regimul TVA.

note.en: The Government scheduled the opening ceremony for 13 July; the motorway entered official service on 14 July at 08:00.
note.ro: Guvernul a programat ceremonia de deschidere pe 13 iulie; autostrada a intrat oficial in exploatare pe 14 iulie la ora 08:00.

note.en: The opening ceremony was held on 13 July 2022; official service began on 14 July 2022 at 08:00.
note.ro: Ceremonia de deschidere a avut loc pe 13 iulie 2022; exploatarea oficiala a inceput pe 14 iulie 2022 la ora 08:00.
